module: GE extension (depends on telemetry_userIdentity) that manages the telemetry configuration: reading the /telemetry/config.json cache, validation, periodic fetching from the server (s11/v1/telemetryConfig, with the clientFacts facts and the anonymous identifier), then application via a callback. It indicates which modules/trackers are enabled (moduleConfigs). Starting with the -telemetryLocal argument enables all trackers with their default values without ever contacting the server or sending anything.
notes: Without a valid configuration, everything is disabled: getModuleConfig always returns the same table {enabled = false} (no allocation).
Validation: enabled boolean; runIds list of <= 32 strings of 4 to 64 characters of the form ^R[A-Z0-9]+$; ttlHours and reportIntervalHours numeric between 1/60 and 168 h.

The cache is reused as long as its age is below ttlHours (24 h by default); a new fetch attempt at most every 300 s; expiry test every 60 s when polling is active and the online session is authenticated.
On a network failure, the last known server configuration is kept.
The telemetry schema version is the string '30'.
The extension is in 'manual' unload mode.

isLocalOnly.desc: Indicates whether the game was launched with -telemetryLocal: all trackers are active with their default values, the server is never queried and nothing is sent.

returns.desc: true if the argument is present.

initializeConfig.desc: Loads the configuration: in local mode, applies an enabled default config; otherwise enables polling, applies the cache if it is valid and recent, otherwise a disabled default config (the actual fetch happens after online authentication).

callback.desc: Called with the config on each application (and stored for later updates).

returns.desc: Config (enabled, ttlHours, reportIntervalHours, runIds, moduleConfigs) or nil before initializeConfig.

getModuleConfig.desc: Returns the configuration of a telemetry module: {enabled = true} in local mode, the moduleConfigs[moduleName] table if it exists, otherwise the shared table {enabled = false}.

returns.desc: Module config (do not modify it: it may be shared).

isModuleEnabled.desc: Indicates whether a module is enabled (getModuleConfig(...).enabled == true).

getSurveyIntervalHours.desc: Sampling interval of a module in hours: surveyIntervalHours, or surveyIntervalDays * 24 for old caches, otherwise the default value. Old caches in days are still read until all installations have picked up the hours format.

defaultHours.desc: Value returned if nothing is configured.

checkConfigExpiry.desc: If the retry delay has elapsed and the config's TTL is exceeded, relaunches fetchConfigFromAPI and applies the new config. At most one attempt every 300 s.

fetchConfigFromAPI.desc: Calls core_online.apiCall('s11/v1/telemetryConfig') sending the client facts and the anonymous identifier. If the response is valid, saves it to /telemetry/config.json and calls callback; otherwise, calls callback with a disabled default config (unless a config already exists).

setPollingEnabled.desc: Enables or turns off polling: installs/removes the onUpdate hooks (expiry test every 60 s if the online session is authenticated) and onOnlineStateChanged (test as soon as connected), then calls extensions.hookUpdate.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Load hook: sets the extension to manual unload mode.
